description: Update a Doc page's title, subtitle or content (ClickUp Docs v3). Use `content_edit_mode` to replace, append to, or prepend the existing content. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated page.

content_edit_mode.description: How `content` is applied: 'replace' (default) overwrites, 'append' adds to the end, 'prepend' adds to the start.

doc_id.description: ID of the Doc the page belongs to.

name.description: New page title. Omit to keep current.

page_id.description: ID of the page to update.

sub_title.description: New subtitle. Omit to keep current.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: update_doc_page
